Main responsibility

Ashen is responsible for the citizen-facing web application where users submit their service needs and receive AI-guided visit preparation.

Step-by-step tasks
Step 1 — Create React/Vite frontend
npm create vite@latest frontend -- --template react
cd frontend
npm install
npm install axios react-router-dom
npm install tailwindcss @tailwindcss/vite

Setup Tailwind.

Step 4 — Citizen request form

Create form fields:

Name
District
Service need / problem description
Available documents
Preferred language

Submit to backend:

POST /api/v1/cases

Then call:

POST /api/v1/ai/analyze
Step 5 — Follow-up questions page

If AI returns missing details, show question cards.

Example:

Which district was your birth certificate issued in?
Do you have the original certificate?
Do you have an affidavit?
